model_contract.bard_movement: prior note aura; fixed point allows each blocked charmed object to remain independently; blocked Bard cancels the turn
model_contract.calibration_limits: sampled oracle agreement is evidence, not a proof of model equivalence
model_contract.door_behavior: opens when all switches are weighed; closing can remove walls and crates or kill heroes
model_contract.hero_loss_pruned: Druid petrifying Bard and closing door on either hero are losing because both heroes are necessary for the two goals
model_contract.noops: permitted where the game permits them
model_contract.objective: first win at or before horizon inputs

redundant_global_landmarks.all_material_switches: some full-history frame has all nine switches occupied by walls or crates
redundant_global_landmarks.border_proof: The nine distinct material tokens on the switches originated as walls at nine distinct border cells. Each token had to be converted at its original cell before it could move. Identity is preserved by transformations and door crushing only deletes tokens. See iii14_strengthening.md.
redundant_global_landmarks.distinct_initial_border_conversions: before any all-material-switch frame, at least nine distinct original border wall positions have been targeted by a Druid wall-to-crate conversion
redundant_global_landmarks.guard: exact original grid and catalog source hash checked before enabling
redundant_global_landmarks.hero_manhattan_cones: each hero is within frame-index distance of its own start and, under one of the two goal assignments, within remaining-horizon distance of its assigned goal
redundant_global_landmarks.proof: Before both heroes first enter the three-cell goal enclosure, a hero occupies a door while neither is on a switch; therefore nine material tokens weigh the switches. Each began as a boundary wall and must have been converted to a crate to reach a switch. A door closure can delete, but not create, material. See structure_system.md.
redundant_global_landmarks.wall_to_crate_events: at least nine Druid wall-to-crate events occur before victory

solver_result_semantics.unsat: no modeled win at or before horizon, subject to model correctness

model_contract.state_encoding: 105-bit masks for walls, crates, each hero and notes; booleans for active hero and door
